notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (dropoff borough highest average fare).

turns.question: Which dropoff borough has the highest average fare amount?

reference.sql: SELECT dz.Borough AS borough, round(avg(t.fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM trips t LEFT JOIN zones dz ON t.DOLocationID = dz.LocationID WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (weekday vs weekend distance and duration).

turns.question: Compare average trip distance and average duration minutes by weekday versus weekend.

reference.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN dayofweek(t.tpep_pickup_datetime) IN (0, 6) THEN 'weekend' ELSE 'weekday' END AS week_part, round(avg(t.trip_distance), 2) AS avg_distance, round(avg(date_diff('second', t.tpep_pickup_datetime, t.tpep_dropoff_datetime) / 60.0), 2) AS avg_duration FROM trips t WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC

notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (payment type highest average total amount).

turns.question: Which payment type has the highest average total amount?

reference.sql: SELECT CASE t.payment_type WHEN 1 THEN 'Credit card' WHEN 2 THEN 'Cash' WHEN 3 THEN 'No charge' WHEN 4 THEN 'Dispute' WHEN 5 THEN 'Unknown' WHEN 6 THEN 'Voided trip' ELSE 'Other' END AS payment, round(avg(t.total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM trips t WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (lowest avg duration pickup borough + trip count).

turns.question: Which pickup borough has the lowest average trip duration in minutes, and what is its trip count?

reference.sql: SELECT pz.Borough AS borough, round(avg(date_diff('second', t.tpep_pickup_datetime, t.tpep_dropoff_datetime) / 60.0), 2) AS avg_duration, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t LEFT JOIN zones pz ON t.PULocationID = pz.LocationID WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 1

notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (compare average tip and average fare across vendors).

turns.question: Compare average tip and average fare across the taxi vendors.

reference.sql: SELECT t.VendorID AS vendor_id, round(avg(t.tip_amount), 2) AS avg_tip, round(avg(t.fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare FROM trips t WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime AND t.VendorID IN (1, 2) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC

notes: Fresh unseen holdout case (rate code with highest average fare and trip count).

turns.question: Which rate code has the highest average fare and how many trips use it?

reference.sql: SELECT t.RatecodeID AS rate_code, round(avg(t.fare_amount), 2) AS avg_fare, count(*) AS trips FROM trips t WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01' AND t.fare_amount >= 0 AND t.total_amount >= 0 AND t.tpep_dropoff_datetime >= t.tpep_pickup_datetime AND t.RatecodeID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
